# BT-GATE-011 QG5 Portable Acceptance Fixture

Portable one-session slice for reproducing BT-GATE-011 outside the local TSIS data tree.

The slice was derived from the previously approved QG5 real-data preflight run:

`runs/run_preflight_real_fixture_2026_01_05_qg5_v0_2/data_preflight_report.json`

It contains only the session rows consumed by the acceptance run. Vendor-derived `vw`
is intentionally not included or consumed.
